payload.title: lift_sandbox_pin's symlink refusal walks the path components and the final open uses O_NOFOLLOW, which covers the last component only, so a seat process that is still running can swap an intermediate directory for a symlink between the check and the open and make the kernel read a file it chose
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:619-620 (the component check, then os.open with O_NOFOLLOW as a separate step)
payload.rule_violated: Check and use are one operation: a path from an untrusted tree is opened with every component refused as a symlink in the same call, not checked and then opened
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens security), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: Each lifted file is opened with no symlink in any component in one call (openat2 with RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS, or a directory descriptor walked component by component with O_NOFOLLOW), or the files are read from a copy the kernel took of the tree after the seat's process stopped. Test: a parent directory swapped for a symlink between the check and the open is refused by the same named error.
